datasets.name: af1cb384
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.usage_date,
  u.workspace_id,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_identity,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.surface AS surface,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.channel AS channel,
  COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id, 'No Agent') AS agent_id,
  u.sku_name,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS total_cost
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
      )
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  u.usage_date DESC

datasets.name: assistant_events
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date,
  workspace_id,
  COUNT(*) AS request_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS unique_requests
FROM
  system.access.assistant_events
WHERE
  event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  event_date DESC

datasets.name: product_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', u.usage_date) AS usage_month,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.surface AS product,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS total_cost,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.identity_metadata.run_as) AS unique_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.workspace_id) AS workspace_count
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
      )
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.usage_metadata.genie.surface IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  usage_month DESC,
  total_dbus DESC

datasets.name: cost_concentration
queryLines:
WITH user_costs AS (
  SELECT
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_identity,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS total_cost,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.usage_date) AS active_days
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  GROUP BY
    1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    user_identity,
    total_cost,
    total_dbus,
    active_days,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS cost_rank,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_user_count,
    SUM(total_cost) OVER () AS grand_total_cost,
    SUM(total_cost) OVER (ORDER BY total_cost DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_cost
  FROM
    user_costs
)
SELECT
  user_identity,
  total_cost,
  total_dbus,
  active_days,
  cost_rank,
  total_user_count,
  ROUND(cumulative_cost / grand_total_cost * 100, 1) AS cumulative_cost_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN cost_rank <= CEIL(total_user_count * 0.1) THEN 'Top 10%'
    WHEN cost_rank <= CEIL(total_user_count * 0.25) THEN 'Top 25%'
    WHEN cost_rank <= CEIL(total_user_count * 0.5) THEN 'Top 50%'
    ELSE 'Bottom 50%'
  END AS user_tier
FROM
  ranked
ORDER BY
  cost_rank

datasets.name: cfo_efficiency
queryLines:
WITH monthly_billing AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.usage_date) AS month,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS total_cost,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.identity_metadata.run_as) AS active_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.workspace_id) AS active_workspaces
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  GROUP BY
    1
),
monthly_requests AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', event_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_requests,
    COUNT(DISTINCT initiated_by) AS requesting_users
  FROM
    system.access.assistant_events
  WHERE
    event_date >= '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY
    1
),
per_user AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.usage_date) AS month,
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_id,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS user_dbus,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS user_cost,
    MIN(u.usage_date) AS first_day
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),
free_tier AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_users_in_month,
    SUM(LEAST(user_dbus, 150)) AS free_dbus,
    SUM(GREATEST(user_dbus - 150, 0)) AS billable_dbus,
    SUM(user_cost) AS total_user_cost,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN user_dbus <= 150 THEN 1
      END
    ) AS users_within_free_tier,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN user_dbus > 150 THEN 1
      END
    ) AS users_exceeding_free_tier
  FROM
    per_user
  GROUP BY
    1
),
first_seen AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MIN(month) AS first_month
  FROM
    per_user
  GROUP BY
    1
),
new_vs_returning AS (
  SELECT
    pu.month,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN pu.month = fs.first_month THEN 1
      END
    ) AS new_users,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN pu.month > fs.first_month THEN 1
      END
    ) AS returning_users
  FROM
    per_user pu
      JOIN first_seen fs
        ON pu.user_id = fs.user_id
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  b.month,
  b.total_cost,
  b.total_dbus,
  b.active_users,
  b.active_workspaces,
  r.total_requests,
  r.requesting_users,
  CASE
    WHEN b.active_users > 0 THEN b.total_cost / b.active_users
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cost_per_user,
  CASE
    WHEN r.total_requests > 0 THEN b.total_cost / r.total_requests
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cost_per_request,
  CASE
    WHEN b.active_users > 0 THEN b.total_dbus / b.active_users
    ELSE NULL
  END AS dbus_per_user,
  CASE
    WHEN b.active_workspaces > 0 THEN b.total_cost / b.active_workspaces
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cost_per_workspace,
  ft.free_dbus,
  ft.billable_dbus,
  ft.users_within_free_tier,
  ft.users_exceeding_free_tier,
  CASE
    WHEN
      (ft.free_dbus + ft.billable_dbus) > 0
    THEN
      ft.free_dbus * 100.0 / (ft.free_dbus + ft.billable_dbus)
    ELSE 0
  END AS free_tier_pct,
  nv.new_users,
  nv.returning_users,
  CASE
    WHEN
      (nv.new_users + nv.returning_users) > 0
    THEN
      nv.returning_users * 100.0 / (nv.new_users + nv.returning_users)
    ELSE 0
  END AS retention_pct
FROM
  monthly_billing b
    LEFT JOIN monthly_requests r
      ON b.month = r.month
    LEFT JOIN free_tier ft
      ON b.month = ft.month
    LEFT JOIN new_vs_returning nv
      ON b.month = nv.month
ORDER BY
  b.month

datasets.name: top_spender_drivers
queryLines:
WITH top_user AS (
  SELECT
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_identity
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  GROUP BY
    1
  ORDER BY
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  u.usage_date,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_identity,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.surface AS surface,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.channel AS channel,
  u.sku_name,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS total_cost
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
      )
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.identity_metadata.run_as IN (
    SELECT
      user_identity
    FROM
      top_user
  )
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  u.usage_date DESC

datasets.name: mom_comparison
queryLines:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.usage_date) AS month,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS total_cost,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.identity_metadata.run_as) AS active_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.workspace_id) AS active_workspaces
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  month,
  total_cost,
  total_dbus,
  active_users,
  active_workspaces,
  LAG(total_cost) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_cost,
  LAG(total_dbus) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_dbus,
  LAG(active_users) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_users,
  CASE
    WHEN
      LAG(total_cost) OVER (ORDER BY month) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(
        (total_cost - LAG(total_cost) OVER (ORDER BY month))
          / LAG(total_cost) OVER (ORDER BY month)
          * 100,
        1
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cost_growth_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN
      LAG(active_users) OVER (ORDER BY month) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(
        (active_users - LAG(active_users) OVER (ORDER BY month))
          * 100.0
          / LAG(active_users) OVER (ORDER BY month),
        1
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS user_growth_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN
      LAG(total_dbus) OVER (ORDER BY month) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(
        (total_dbus - LAG(total_dbus) OVER (ORDER BY month))
          / LAG(total_dbus) OVER (ORDER BY month)
          * 100,
        1
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS dbu_growth_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN active_users > 0 THEN total_cost / active_users
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cost_per_user,
  LAG(
    CASE
      WHEN active_users > 0 THEN total_cost / active_users
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_cost_per_user
FROM
  monthly
ORDER BY
  month DESC

datasets.name: billed_genie_usage
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.account_id,
  u.workspace_id,
  u.usage_date,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS run_as_user,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.surface AS genie_surface,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.channel AS genie_channel,
  u.sku_name,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS dbus,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS list_cost
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time
      )
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
GROUP BY
  u.account_id,
  u.workspace_id,
  u.usage_date,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.surface,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.channel,
  u.sku_name
ORDER BY
  u.usage_date DESC

datasets.name: free_paid_by_user
datasets.displayName: Free vs Paid Genie Usage by User
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', u.usage_date) AS usage_month,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_identity,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.surface AS genie_surface,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS free_dbus,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN u.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS paid_dbus
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('month', u.usage_date),
  u.identity_metadata.run_as,
  u.usage_metadata.genie.surface
ORDER BY
  usage_month DESC,
  user_identity,
  genie_surface

datasets.name: free_paid_split_current
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Free' AS usage_type,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS dbus
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
  AND u.usage_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Paid' AS usage_type,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS dbus
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
  AND u.usage_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
